$comment: Copy to addressium.config.json (gitignored) before `cdk deploy`. These bootstrap the SHARED control plane. `cdk deploy` creates the admin Cognito pool and seeds each adminEmail as a user — Cognito emails them a temporary-password invite so someone can actually sign in. After first login, invite the rest of the team from the console. Per-org subscriber pools are NOT set here; they're created (or linked to an existing pool) when you Add an organization.
$comment_alerts: Where infrastructure alarms go (DLQ depth, queue age, Lambda errors/throttles, DynamoDB throttles). Set opsAlertTopicArn to an SNS topic you already own — alert routing is your infrastructure, not ours. If you have no topic yet, set opsAlertEmail instead and addressium will create one and subscribe that address. Set NEITHER and every alarm fires into a void: `npm run deploy:check` will warn you.
$comment_waf: addressium does NOT create WAF WebACLs — a resource carries only one, so ours would displace yours and silently reattach on every deploy. Create your own (REGIONAL for the API, CLOUDFRONT-scope in us-east-1 for the SPAs), attach them to the ApiStageArn / AdminDistributionId / PublicDistributionId stack outputs, and record the ARNs here. `npm run deploy:check` warns when these are unset.
